title: Taiwan Price Limit Latent Volatility (GJR-GARCH-X)
conclusion: NULL RESULT: Price limit dummy does NOT significantly improve GJR-GARCH forecasts. QLIKE: Base=-8.0448, X5=-8.0433, X3=-8.0488. DM(Base vs X5) t=-0.22 p=0.8233, DM(Base vs X3) t=1.07 p=0.2847. Limit events (39 days @ >5%) are too infrequent or their vol impact is already captured by GARCH asymmetry terms.

methodology.evaluation: QLIKE on r² (Patton 2011), DM test (Harvey et al. 1997)
methodology.lag: signal.shift(1) via exog index: exog[t-1] is used in variance at t

references: Patton A.J. (2011). Volatility forecast comparison using imperfect volatility proxies. JoE.
Harvey, Leybourne & Newbold (1997). Testing equality of prediction MSEs. IJoF.
Huang & Liu (2014). Price limits and stock market volatility in Taiwan. JFEC.
